description: This is a Flutter widget class named PaymentFragment that provides a UI for selecting and initiating various payment methods, including wallet balance, QR code payment, and deep-link launching of external payment apps such as Paytm, Mobikwik, and Google Pay. It also includes a payment confirmation dialog flow.

classes.name: PaymentFragment
classes.description: A Flutter StatelessWidget that builds a payment options UI with wallet info, QR code, external app links, and a payment confirmation dialog.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the payment screen, including wallet display, payment method links, and a pay button.

methods.name: _buildPaymentTile
methods.description: Creates a card widget representing a payment method with an icon, name, and a tappable link to launch external apps.

methods.name: _launchApp
methods.description: Attempts to open a deep link to an external payment app, showing a fallback message if unsuccessful.

methods.name: _showPaymentDialog
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog with options to complete or cancel the payment, showing a SnackBar message accordingly.
